product_metadata.title: Baimo 2 Pack 100 LED 8 Modes Battery Operated String Lights, 33ft Remote Control Timer Waterproof Silver Copper Wire Fairy Lights for Christmas, Garden, Patio, Indoor Outdoor (Multicolor)
features: Waterproof and Timer Function: These battery case and light string are IP65 waterproof, very suitable for both indoor and outdoor using, without any worry of short circuit or heavy rain. You can set timer, the lights will be 6 hours on and 18 hours off per day.

8 Lighting Modes and Memory Function: Combination, in wave, sequential, slo glo, chasing/flash, slow fade, fairy/flash and steady on, creating aesthetic atmosphere for your environment. The lights always remember the last mode before closing.

Energy Saving and Safe: Use high quality copper with silver coating, light weight, rustproof , and more efficient use of energy and do not overheat while a long time usage. The nice flexibility of copper allows you mold it into any shape as you want without worrying about the wire will break.

Remote Control: This fairy lights come with a wireless remote control, point the remote to the battery case in any direction to turn on/off the lights, set timer, chose mode, adjust brightness. All is in your control!

Wide Application: Perfect for outdoor and indoor decoration, garden, yard, party, wedding, holiday, christmas, porch, tree, roof and so on. And the silver wire disappeared into the night, Leaving only light.
